map.输入安防产品关键性能参数，按GB标准判定安全防护等级: Enter key performance parameters of security products, judge the safety protection level per GB standards
map.安防产品按国家标准判定防护等级：防盗安全门依据 GB 17565 按抗破坏净工作: Security products are graded per national standards: anti-theft security doors are divided into four grades by GB 17565 by net anti-destruction working time - Grade A (30 min), Grade B (15 min), Grade C (10 min), Grade D (6 min); electronic anti-theft locks are graded by GA 374 by resistance time and lock-body steel-plate thickness; the judgement is based on anti-destruction time meeting the standard, material thickness not below the standard value, and lock and response times meeting requirements; any indicator failing means not qualified.
map.采购防盗安全门或电子防盗锁时，输入抗破坏时间、钢板厚度、防技术开启时间，按国标判: When purchasing anti-theft security doors or electronic anti-theft locks, enter anti-destruction time, steel-plate thickness and anti-picking time, and judge per national standard whether the protection grade is met.
map.工程验收或产品检测环节，将实测参数代入，对照 GB 17565 / GA 374: In engineering acceptance or product testing, substitute the measured parameters and issue a qualified conclusion against standards such as GB 17565 / GA 374.
map.选型比价时，用同一套阈值快速区分「甲级门」与「丙级门」、「C 级锁」与「A 级锁: When selecting and comparing prices, use the same set of thresholds to quickly distinguish the protection gap between 'Grade A door' and 'Grade C door', 'Class C lock' and 'Class A lock'.
map.判定规则（执行标准 GB 17565）：抗破坏时间 rt≥30 分钟 且 钢板厚: Grading rule (standard GB 17565): anti-destruction time rt≥30 min AND steel-plate thickness sp≥1.8mm AND anti-picking lt≥10 min -> Special grade; rt≥15 AND sp≥1.2 AND lt≥5 -> Grade A; rt≥10 AND sp≥1.0 AND lt≥5 -> Grade B; rt≥6 AND sp≥1.0 AND lt≥1 -> Grade C; otherwise not qualified. Example: rt=20, sp=1.5, lt=8 meets Grade A thresholds (rt≥15, sp≥1.2, lt≥5) -> graded 'Grade A'. Electronic anti-theft lock (GA 374): lt≥30 -> Class C, ≥10 -> Class B, ≥5 -> Class A; video surveillance (GB/T 28181) and intrusion alarm (GB 15463) by environmental-adaptability score es: ≥8 -> Grade I, ≥6 -> Grade II, ≥4 -> Grade III, otherwise Grade IV.
map.门和锁的等级为什么分开判定？: Why are door and lock grades judged separately?
map.二者执行标准不同（门 GB 17565、锁 GA 374），防护维度也不同：门看: The two execute different standards (door GB 17565, lock GA 374) and differ in protection dimension: the door looks at overall anti-destruction time and steel-plate thickness, while the lock separately looks at anti-picking time. The safety of a whole anti-theft door takes the weaker of 'door body + lock', so the lock should at least reach a grade comparable to the door body (e.g. Grade A door with Class B/C lock).
map.判定为「不合格」还能用吗？: Can something graded 'not qualified' still be used?
map.不合格表示未达该品类最低防护阈值，不建议用于需要防盗的场景；可能是钢板过薄、抗破: Not qualified means the minimum protection threshold for that category is not met; it is not recommended for scenarios requiring anti-theft; it may be due to too-thin steel plate, insufficient anti-destruction time or too-low lock grade. Regular products should obtain 3C certification; when purchasing, rely on the physical test report and certification mark, and this tool is only a parametric reference.
map.防盗安全门按GB 17565，甲级抗破坏≥15min，乙级≥10min，丙级≥6: Anti-theft security door per GB 17565: Grade A anti-destruction ≥15min, Grade B ≥10min, Grade C ≥6min
map.电子防盗锁按GA 374，A级防技术开启≥5min，B级≥10min，C级≥30: Electronic anti-theft lock per GA 374: Class A anti-picking ≥5min, Class B ≥10min, Class C ≥30min
map.安防产品应通过3C认证方可上市销售: Security products should pass 3C certification before sale
map.安防产品质量检测工具，输入抗破坏时间、钢板厚度、锁具防开启时间等参数，按GB标准: A security-product quality-testing tool that enters parameters such as anti-destruction time, steel-plate thickness and lock anti-opening time, and judges the safety protection grade per GB standards.
